thread:
arjun: Heads-up  opened a PR to align terminology across the style-guide, phrasebank, and SDK snippets. It merges a couple of glossary keys and updates a few quick examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5231
lilly: thanks. does this change any public quickstarts?
arjun: tried to keep quickstarts stable. For widely copied snippets I left visible values and added a one-line deprecation comment with the new recommended catalog id.
nate: can you paste that deprecation text so editorial can sign off?
arjun: sure: "Deprecated: `gpt-3` alias. Use explicit catalog ids like `rw/gpt-small` for predictable results. See migration notes."
cecilia: editorial nit  prefer shorter: "Deprecated: `gpt-3`. Use `rw/<model-id>`." also, prefer 'we' in step language (e.g., "Set your API key").
megan: SDK impact? which snippets are changing?
arjun: small JS param-case updates (camelCase -> snake_case) in a few internal examples, python model-id recommendation, and a tiny Go doc comment. I added migration commands: macOS + Linux sed, ripgrep examples, and npm/pip upgrade lines.
nate: please keep anchor redirects for renamed glossary terms. I noticed 'inference runtime' -> 'serving runtime' rename earlier and that broke a couple links.
arjun: added redirect anchors and kept the old human-readable alias in parentheses on the main glossary page. Also updated internal links across docs/* where obvious.
docs-bot: preview available: https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/5231 :white_check_mark:
cecilia: editorial will run a quick pass after merge focusing on contraction guidance and the deprecation tone. I flagged one sentence about urgency language.
lilly: CI note  can we schedule docs/regenerate-snapshots and linkcheck after merge?
arjun: added CI triggers in the PR. aiming to merge by 6pm PT if no blockers.
megan: i'll finish the JS snippet pass by 3pm PT and run local linkcheck.
nate: i'll add a release-note line after merge: "Docs: consolidated terminology, updated SDK snippets & migration notes."
arjun: thanks all. ping me if you find anything blocking and i'll hold the merge. :rocket:
